_comment: African tech/startup podcast RSS feeds, verified to parse and to carry audio enclosures. Podcast RSS is the ingestion channel that YouTube rate limiting cannot affect: the XML and the audio are served by the publisher, not by YouTube. Episodes without captions are transcribed locally with faster-whisper. Discover more by name with GET /api/podcasts/search?term=...
